note: State fault-allocation rule governing whether/how a plaintiff's own percentage of fault reduces or bars recovery. 'pure' = damages reduced by fault % with no bar, even at 99% at fault. 'modified-50' = barred once plaintiff is 50% or more at fault (must be strictly less than 50% to recover). 'modified-51' = barred once plaintiff is more than 50% at fault (51%+ bars, exactly 50% still recovers a reduced amount). 'contributory' = any amount of plaintiff fault (even 1%) bars recovery entirely. Verify with a licensed attorney in your state before relying on this — some states carve out exceptions (e.g. willful/wanton conduct) not modeled here.
